notes: Searching a forest for a missing person is exploration with an objective, so Adventure, and the Exploration preset gives the right space — one contiguous world-open forest walked in any order, kept to a few minutes across per the scale answer, which keeps it on P0 as a single surface. The missing person lands on npc-population as a named non-hostile figure and the ground they are found on, not spawner-npc, since nothing here is hostile despite the eerie tone the theme answer asked for. path-trail threads the woods so the search has a grain to follow, landmark-focal keeps players oriented among repeating trees, and alcove-secret gives the person a hollow or thicket to actually be hidden in. Decided without a user that finding the person is where the run ends, so no separate exit or gate was placed; using the player's own avatar is a character-loading detail with no layout consequence.
